title: Cloud-Safe Reset & A Single Version File
changes: Sentence-bridge word matching now recognises conjugated and inflected forms of a companion word, not just an exact text match, so far more genuine sentence pairs are found among the words in a session.

When no two brand-new words share a real sentence, the sentence bridge now falls back to pairing a new word with one you already know from the same session, so a freshly learned word is cemented inside a real sentence far more often instead of being skipped.
The sentence-bridge card now lists every connecting word (particle or grammar ending) in the sentence with a plain-English explanation of its job, instead of a single hard-coded です note.

Resetting local progress while signed in now also erases the synced cloud copy immediately, so old progress can no longer reappear from the cloud after a reset. The reset button locks while this happens so it can't be triggered twice mid-reset.
The app version now lives in exactly one file (version.js) instead of five, so a release only needs that one number changed for every part of the app — and the offline install banner — to pick it up.
